resale_co.name: Land Use Compliance Certificate for a property sale (Certificate of Occupancy and/or Land Use Compliance Certificate)
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Longport Building and Zoning Department
requirements: Dwelling must comply with federal, state and local housing codes
Kept in a safe, sanitary condition with proper and adequate light and ventilation
Open permit review before the certificate is issued

fees.label: Land Use Compliance application for a sale
fees.quote: Application for Land Use Compliance of a Property for Sale Application Fee: $150.00

resale_co.how_to_apply: Complete the 'Application for Land Use Compliance of a Property for Sale' (Housing section of the Borough forms page) with the settlement date, a point of contact and access details, and submit it with the $150.00 fee, a current site survey, a flood elevation certificate, the sales contract or proof of sale price, and Form 1A (smoke detector certificate) to the Building and Zoning Department, 2305 Atlantic Avenue, Longport, NJ 08403. The Building Department inspects and then issues the certificate.

evidence.quote: A Certificate of Occupancy and/or Land Use Compliance Certificate will be issued following an inspection by the Building Department.
Required documents to be submitted with this application Ordinance §70-2
Building and Zoning Department 2305 Atlantic Avenue ∙ Longport, New Jersey 08403-1103 Office: 609.823.2731 ext. 108, 109, 120 ∙ Fax: 609.823.9480 Email: building@longport-nj.us

resale_co.notes: The Borough's sale packet (June 2026) is titled 'Application for Land Use Compliance of a Property for Sale' and cites Ordinance §70-2; the Building Department inspects and issues a Certificate of Occupancy and/or Land Use Compliance Certificate. The form gives no lead time or validity period. No named construction or zoning official is listed on the Borough website (forms and directory checked); the office numbers are ext. 108, 109 and 120 (Zoning/Flood ext. 120, zoning@longport-nj.us). The Borough code (ecode360 LO0700) could not be opened. A separate Rental Application exists for rentals.

requirements: Smoke alarms on each level, in every bedroom, and outside each sleeping area within 10 feet of doorways
Since January 1, 2019: 10-year sealed lithium battery single-station smoke alarms; existing AC-powered alarms are accepted and must not be removed
Carbon monoxide alarms on each level and outside sleeping areas
Central-station monitored alarm systems must be inspected by a NJ certified fire protection contractor, with the report available at the fire inspection
Owner, agent or designee must be present; detectors mounted more than 9 feet up must be tested by the owner or agent
A penalty of up to $500.00 may apply if the sale closes before the certificate is received

authorities.how_to_apply: Complete Form 1A (Application for Certificate of Smoke Detector Compliance) in the Borough sale packet and submit it with the Land Use Compliance application. Inspection by the Longport Fire Official, by appointment only. Pay by check only, payable to Longport Bureau of Fire Prevention; no certificate is issued before the fee is paid.
